about: Inputs for the baseline vs. fast-path timeline chart. Baseline phase durations are ASSUMPTIONS from the challenge brief, not law. Fast-path clocks are statutory maximums with their source. A null value means our sources do not supply it, and the chart shows 'unknown'. The page picks the path from the shared project panel (type, pre-approved plan, existing home). SB 9 / SB 684 / SB 4 / AB 2011 entries are kept for future project types but are not selectable today.

baseline.label: Baseline (typical project)
baseline.basis: Rounded estimates for a typical project from the event challenge brief (lanes/2-clear-it/data/timeline.json, docs/background.md): rezoning about 1 year, entitlements about 1 year, plans 6 to 12 months, build about 1 year. Not measurements, not law.

completeness.text: not broken out in the brief (inside entitlements)

rezoning.basis: Fast path starts on land already zoned correctly (challenge brief fast path, step 1).

day_conversions.note: ASSUMPTION for display: 1 month = 30.44 calendar days; business days × 7/5 to get calendar days (ignores holidays).

decision.source: No separate ADU clock: the city may decide the ADU together with the new home's permit (HCD ADU Handbook p. 11). The new home's own approval time is not in our sources.
